summary.short: Authorizes and directs Department of Energy Office of Science and NIST research programs, with fiscal 2023-2027 funding authorizations. Bars entities of concern from receiving federal research support. Includes AI-related research and biometric performance standards.
summary.long: Headed Research and Development, Competition, and Innovation Act, the text authorizes research programs and fiscal 2023-2027 appropriations. Title I amends the Department of Energy Research and Innovation Act for Office of Science programs (basic energy sciences, biological and environmental research, advanced computing, fusion, high energy and nuclear physics, isotopes, accelerators, laboratory upgrades) with start-of-operations deadlines. It adds AI-related research, including autonomous chemistry facilities and bias-mitigation guidance for high-performance computing. Section 10114 bars entities of concern and linked individuals from covered research support, subject to a Secretary waiver and exclusions of one to ten years. Title II directs NIST measurement research on engineering biology, greenhouse gas measurement and biometrics, including a biometrics test program, performance standards for high-risk biometric identification systems, and AI-enabled cybersecurity research, plus voluntary standards for software, cloud, privacy and identity management. Later sections listed in the outline cover NSF education and workforce programs, foreign funding, and microelectronics and DOE RD&D; their text is not in this part.
